in_code_at_entry: manifest identity: validate-reference reads only CALL-LIST-v4.json and refuses it unless it is byte-identical to what this tree generates (every source pin, reference input, raw layout hash, the predicate and the accounting); the prior snapped manifest is refused

listed calls only: the call id with its listed --timeout, and the engine, reference and grid when given; before the window closes; on the listed architecture; on POSIX only, because the CPU limit is RLIMIT_CPU (Linux and macOS; Windows has no RLIMIT_CPU, and its equivalent, a Job Object process-time limit, is not implemented, so the entry refuses there); never under CI allocation (CI_ALLOCATION=1), where every native HotSpot launch goes through sundai_hotspot.ci_gate and SLAB-049 solves never run

evaluator identity: identity markers and SHA-256 are read from a private content-addressed copy (mode 0500 in a 0700 directory), and that copy is the file executed; build provenance must describe exactly those bytes; a binary built with the CI entry guard is refused; the shared libraries the loader resolves must equal the build's, and are hashed again after the run (a change settles the call as runtime_changed)
raw geometry: the pinned raw layout hash (the vendored copy, and SLAB-048's record whenever it is in the tree) and the continuous rules only; the search lattice is never applied

atomic admission: under an exclusive ledger lock, one manifest per ledger, each call reserved once (O_EXCL, no retries), refused when the admitted count would pass 12 or charged plus reserved CPU would pass 600 CPU-s (settled calls are charged their measured CPU, unsettled ones their reservation)
reserve before staging: the reservation and the receipt are on disk (fsync) before inputs are generated or the solver starts

per-process CPU and a separate wall deadline: the solver runs in its own session and process group under RLIMIT_CPU equal to its timeout (soft = hard, so SIGKILL at the limit) and a wall deadline equal to its timeout; the TAP generator runs under RLIMIT_CPU 10 s and a 60 s deadline
kill and reap: after the solver exits or times out, its process group is killed and the solver is reaped
settlement: the receipt and the ledger settlement are written durably on every exit path of this process, keeping the raw outputs, the status, the measured CPU (children and self) and any overshoot
outcomes by admitted call id: record and report read the ledger, never caller-chosen directories; a missing required outcome gives INCOMPLETE
operator_supervisor_contract: admission identity: authenticate the operator and the host; keep the ledger append-only and protected from deletion or rewrite (deleting a reservation would readmit its call); one ledger per grant

a cumulative CPU budget over the whole process group, descendants and lifecycle work included, enforced while calls run (for example a cgroup v2 budget that kills at the limit); in code, RLIMIT_CPU is per process and the ledger's cumulative check acts at admission only
kill and reap if validate-reference itself dies (SIGKILL, OOM, host loss): settle the call as unknown, charge its reservation, and never let it become a free replacement

a protected runtime image: run the loader and libraries from immutable copies; in code, the executable is a private copy, but libraries are hashed before and after the run, which cannot detect a swap-and-restore during it
a trusted clock for the grant window; the code reads the host clock
the final grant reconciles the 600 CPU-s manifest cap with the room's 1,800 CPU-s envelope; neither is raised here

predicate.deferred: pending verification: no calls in this allocation; cannot pass or fail this gate
predicate.fail: a completed required call misses the tolerance, or a replay's outputs differ from its primary's
predicate.incomplete: a required outcome is missing (never admitted), unsettled, or did not complete (any settlement other than 'exited' with status 0): STOP. Never PASS, and not retried under this grant
predicate.metric: block-centre metric: TAP-2.5D run_hotspot selector, the max over the steady file's block temperatures with grid_map_mode center from TAP's config, 64x64, minus 273.15
predicate.not_judged: the grid 32 calls and the native7 comparator are reported, never judged
pass: every required call was admitted in the grant's ledger, settled 'exited' with status 0, and its raw evidence verifies against its receipt, its ledger settlement, the frozen inputs and the manifest
every required call's block-centre metric is within 1.0 K of the paper: the primary and the replay each
each replay's sample.steady and sample.grid.steady are byte-identical to its primary's
